rows.name: EDDYSTONE
rows.character: One 2-flashing br. lt., ½ min., & low fix. br. lt.
rows.description: New granite lt.-ho., 168 ft. high, S. by E. ¾ E. from old tower. Two quick flashes in every ½ min. A lower fix. br. lt. shown over Hand Deeps, betw. N.W. by N. ½ N. and N.W. ¾ W.

rows.name: Fowey
rows.description: A fixed red harbour light

rows.name: FALMOUTH
rows.character: 1. One rev. br. lt., 20 s., and lower fixed br. lt. 2. Two fixed green lts.
rows.description: 1. White lt.-ho., 62 ft. high, on St. Anthony Point. The lower lt. shows betw. S.W. by S. ¼ S. and S. by W., to clear Manacle Rocks 2. On ends of breakwaters

rows.name: LIZARD
rows.description: Two white towers, each 61 ft. high, W. by N. and E. by S., 223 ft. ayart, on the Lizard Cliff. In one lead clear of the Manacles, and Wolf Rk. A signal & telegraph station on Beast Pt., about ¾ of a mile to E.

rows.name: WOLF ROCK
rows.description: A noble granite tower, 143 feet high. Flashes red and bright alternately

rows.name: Penzance
rows.description: On the South pier-head. Red, or when less than 15 ft. water green, betw. E. by S. ¾ S. and S. by W. ½ W.; the remainder bright. By day, a ball while 15 feet

rows.name: LONGSHIPS
rows.character: One occulting bright or red light, 1 min.
rows.description: Gray granite tower, 117 ft. high. Lt. suddenly eclipsed for 3 secs. every minute. Bright light seaward, from N.E. by N. ½ N., or half a mile West of Brisons Rocks, to S. by E. ½ E., or ¾ of a mile West of Runnelstone; red in-shore of these bearings

rows.name: SEVEN STONES LT.-VES.
rows.description: On East side of rocks, in 40 fathoms; red, with ball. Shows three quick flashes, followed by 36 secs. darkness

rows.name: SCILLY
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: White tower, 74 feet high, on summit of St. Agnes Island. Obscured by islands from N. ½ E. to E. ½ S.

rows.name: BISHOP ROCK
rows.description: A noble granite tower, 147 feet high, on the S.W. rock. Lt. invisible to eastward betw. N.E. ¾ E. and E. ½ S., except to E. by N. Light shows two quick flashes of 4 secs. each, followed by 48 secs. eclipse. Lighthouse being heightened, and light will gradually be elevated to 143 ft.

rows.name: St. Ives
rows.description: On inner pier-head, while 10 ft. water; from September 1 to April 30. Also a fixed red light near end of outer wooden pier

rows.name: Hayle
rows.character: 1. Two fix. br. Tide lts. 2. One fixed red light
rows.description: 1. On W. side of entrance; in one S. by W. ¾ W., 297 feet apart; shown while 12 feet water 2. On jetty of Lelant Quays

rows.name: GODREVY
rows.character: One flash. br. lt., 10 secs. Lower fixed red light
rows.description: Stone tower, 86 ft. high, on the island. Lower red light shown over Stones Rocks, between N.W. and N. by W.

rows.name: Padstow
rows.description: A fixed red or green light on quay head

rows.name: TREVOSE HEAD
rows.description: White tower, 87 ft. high, on N.W. extremity. Light eclipsed 3 times in quick succession in 15 secs., and then visible for 45 secs.

rows.name: HARTLAND POINT
rows.description: White tower, showing one flash at intervals of 30 secs., two bright and one red

rows.name: LUNDY ISLAND
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., 2 min. Lower fixed bright light
rows.description: In one white tower, 96 feet high, half a mile from South end of island. Low light visible to West between N. by W. and S.W.

rows.name: BIDEFORD
rows.description: White towers, 311 yards apart, on Braunton Sands, N. side of entrance. In one, S.E. ½ E., lead over bar. High light vis. betw. W.S.W. and N.N.W.; obscured betw. N.N.W. and E. ½ N., over Baggy Leap and Asp Rks.; a lt. of less power vis. in harb. from E. ½ N., through South, to W.S.W. Low lt. only shown from half-flood to half-ebb, while 15 ft. over bar; appears full between West and N.W. by N. ½ N.

rows.name: BULL POINT
rows.character: One 3-flash. br. lt., ½ m., and lower fixed red lt.
rows.description: White tower. Light shows three quick flashes, followed by 18 secs. darkness, every ½ min. Red light, 18 ft. lower, shows betw. W. by S. and N.W. by W. ½ W., to mark Morte Stone

rows.name: Ilfracombe
rows.description: Fix. red lt. on Lantern Hill. (Sept. 1 to Apl. 30)
